learning_outcomes.text: Understanding of technical, economical, and environmental properties of natural gas combustion systems and installations, their design and application
Applications of engineering analyses, design and optimization methods to research, system development, design, operation and optimization of natural gas
Natural gas supplies exterior and interior design and optimization
Calculating the parameters of emission of gas plants

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Scope of natural gas engineering, status of natural gas in fossil fuels, comparison of natural gas with other technical gaseous fuels
Formation and reserves of natural gas. Production of rough natural gas and processing. Transportation of natural gas in gaseous and liquid form, its storage
Utilization of natural gas in domestic, industrial, transportation, energy-conversion and agricultural sectors and the related thermal and natural gas.
Engineering approach in design of exterior and interior natural gas piping installations. High, medium and low pressure natural gas distribution network.
Design calculations of low pressure natural gas interior piping installations, piping calculations, design, applications and optimization
Design calculations of medium pressure natural gas interior piping installations, boiler house, boiler components and auxiliaries
Physical, combustion and emission properties of natural gas and their effects on system design
Combustion of natural gas and combustion calculation
Classification of natural gas flames, their formation, radiation and emission properties. Calculation of flame emissivities and condensation temperature.
Heat transfer properties of natural gas fired boilers, shaping and dimensioning of the combustion chambers.
Fuel preparation and combustion systems for natural gas. Pressure and flow rate control of natural gas.
Natural gas fired boilers, waste heat boilers for gas turbines and combined cycle power plants
Engineering approaches used in the design of the natural gas fired boilers
Experimental determination of the thermal performance and emissions properties of natural gas fired boilers. Emission parameters and emission calculation.
bibliography: R.H.P.PERRY, C.H.CHILTON, Chemical Engineers, Handbook. M.L.NAYYAR, Piping Handbook, Mc Graw-Hill Inc, 1992.
